title: Receive what is given under Hukam
summary: This meets the struggle with outcomes you did not choose. The line places giving and receiving back under the Lord's will.
takeaway: Receive what Hukam places in your hands.
lifeApplication: Before calling the moment unfair, open the hand once and say the line. Let receiving become cleaner than resisting.

source.shortMeaning: What comes is governed by the Lord's pleasure, and we receive under Hukam.
source.lifeApplication: When resistance rises, unclench the hand and receive what has been placed there.

evidence.coreClaim: What comes is governed by the Lord's pleasure, and we receive under Hukam.
evidence.turn: Learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before calling the moment unfair, open the hand once and say the line. Let receiving become cleaner than resisting.
